name: rccar-rev0-perfboard
title: RC car revision 0 — 24×18 perfboard
subtitle: Component side and solder side · coordinates a–X / 1–18 · off-board wires use labelled landing pads

components.label: Adafruit DRV8833 #3297
components.title: Adafruit DRV8833 #3297
components.subtitle: Top/component view · rotated 180 degrees · channel A only
components.body: Physical 2.54 mm pin grid. VM is the unprotected header input. Leave ISENSE jumpers open.

components.label: Pololu U3V16F5 #4941
components.title: Pololu U3V16F5 #4941
components.subtitle: Top/component view · rotated clockwise; board extends right from pins
components.body: Pins are VOUT, GND, VIN top-to-bottom after rotating the module clockwise.

components.label: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
components.title: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
components.subtitle: Top/component view · USB-C faces board edge above row 1
components.body: Two 2.54 mm rows six holes apart. Verify Sense-board D2/SD-CS configuration before using the SD card.

components.label: RAW+ ← master switch
components.title: Raw-positive wire landing pad
components.subtitle: From selected throw of off-board master MTS102
components.body: Direct-soldered, strain-relieved power wire. Charger and switch remain off-board.

components.label: MOTOR M1 / M2 →
components.title: Motor wire landing pads
components.subtitle: To off-board DNG-16016
components.body: Two direct-soldered, strain-relieved motor wires. Confirm direction before final marking.

components.label: XIAO SW COM / RETURN
components.title: Off-board XIAO power-switch wires
components.subtitle: To COM and back from selected throw of MTS102
components.body: The switch is panel-mounted. Its unused ON-ON throw must be insulated.

components.label: SERVO GND / +5V / SIG
components.title: SG90 wire landing pads
components.subtitle: Off-board servo: brown / red / yellow
components.body: Use a keyed connection or direct solder with strain relief; verify the owned lead colours.
